http_listen_address.description: IP address to bind HTTP listeners on. Use 0.0.0.0 to bind all interfaces.

https_listen_address.description: IP address to bind HTTPS listeners on. Use 0.0.0.0 to bind all interfaces.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate (in PEM format, optionally with private key).

ssl_ciphers.description: SSL cipher list (OpenSSL cipher string format). Leave empty to use defaults.

client_header_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for client to send request headers.

client_body_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for client to send request body.

backend_read_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a response from backend.

max_request_size_mb.description: Maximum allowed size (MB) of an incoming request body.

services.description: List of backend services to load balance.
